name: French Toast Cold Brew Latte
caffeineNote: Label: "Contains 255mg caffeine", printed below the ingredients, with "Caffeine contents may vary"
summary: French-toast-flavored cold brew latte on reduced-fat milk, read off the can at 255 mg of caffeine per 11 fl oz, with 28 g of sugar (16 g of it added, as cane sugar), 8 g of protein and 210 calories. This is Bones' Cold Brew Latte line, not their French Toast Latte: that can is a different recipe from the flavored-latte line, at 200 mg and 16 g of sugar. The panel matches the Holy Cannoli Cold Brew Latte's line for line except carbohydrate, 32 g here to 31 g. No price yet: we have not confirmed what Bones charges for this flavor.
